{"question": "Who was the NFL Commissioner in early 2012?", "sources": [{"source_id": "squad-context-1db0cd5d7127a86b1a900c37558ba9c8baccde5ae42c65591dfe73499f5d89b7", "text": "In early 2012, NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell stated that the league planned to make the 50th Super Bowl \"spectacular\" and that it would be \"an important game for us as a league\"."}, {"source_id": "squad-context-0fc4e54e36ca9a7e7bcc6307e06678b838dfe2a7345f8724167d8c070764fd86", "text": "The Broncos took an early lead in Super Bowl 50 and never trailed. Denver linebacker Von Miller was named Super Bowl MVP, recording five solo tackles, 2½ sacks, and two forced fumbles."}, {"source_id": "squad-context-e4eb85a6a9a4d75863d591c947ab4564662ade5a84d5bf5272cf3c2f84abdf17", "text": "Tesla went on to pursue his ideas of wireless lighting and electricity distribution in his high-voltage, high-frequency power experiments in New York and Colorado Springs, and made early (1893) pronouncements on the possibility of wireless communication with his devices. He tried to put these ideas to practical use in an ill-fated attempt at intercontinental wireless transmission, his unfinished Wardenclyffe Tower project. In his lab he also conducted a range of experiments with mechanical oscillators/generators, electrical discharge tubes, and early X-ray imaging. He also built a wireless controlled boat, one of the first ever exhibited."}]}
